Problem Statement:
Write a program that checks if a given number is prime using control statements. The program should read an integer and determine whether it is a prime number. A prime number is a number greater than 1 that has no divisors other than 1 and itself. 
Input Description:
A single integer. 
Output Description:
"Prime" if the number is prime, otherwise "Not Prime". 
Sample Input:
5 
Sample Output:
Prime
